name: lua_use_hold
code:
local scn, done = ...
for _, e in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("prop_physics")) do e:Remove() end
local bot = player.GetBots()[1]
local start, ang = Vector(700, -600, -143.6), Angle(40, 90, 0)
local crate = ents.Create("prop_physics") crate:SetModel("models/props_junk/wood_crate001a.mdl")
crate:SetPos(Vector(700, -550, -123.6)) crate:Spawn() crate:Activate()
local phys = crate:GetPhysicsObject() if IsValid(phys) then phys:EnableMotion(false) end
local uses, samples, t, other = {}, {}, -30, nil
local function held(tk)
  -- 1: E held on the crate t 0..39, 2: E held on the other bot t 100..139, 3: taps on the crate at 200, 202, 204
  if tk >= 0 and tk < 40 then return IN_USE end
  if tk >= 100 and tk < 140 then return IN_USE end
  if tk == 200 or (tk >= 210 and tk < 212) or (tk >= 220 and tk < 225) then return IN_USE end
  return 0
end
hook.Add("PlayerUse", "parity_use_hold", function(ply, ent)
  if ply == bot then uses[#uses+1] = { t = t, ent = ent:GetClass(), other = ent == other, crate = ent == crate } end
end)
hook.Add("KeyPress", "parity_use_hold", function(ply, key)
  if ply == bot and key == IN_USE then uses[#uses+1] = { t = t, press = true } end
end)
hook.Add("StartCommand", "parity_use_hold", function(ply, cmd)
  if ply == other then cmd:ClearButtons() cmd:ClearMovement() return end
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  cmd:ClearButtons() cmd:ClearMovement()
  cmd:SetButtons(held(t))
  cmd:SetViewAngles(ang)
end)
hook.Add("SetupMove", "parity_use_hold", function(ply, mv, cmd)
  if ply == other and t < 150 then mv:SetOrigin(Vector(700, -540, -143.6)) mv:SetVelocity(Vector(0,0,0)) return end
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  if t < 0 then mv:SetOrigin(start) mv:SetVelocity(Vector(0,0,0)) mv:SetButtons(0) else mv:SetButtons(held(t)) end
end)
hook.Add("Think", "parity_use_hold", function()
  t = t + 1
  if t == 60 then
    if IsValid(phys) then phys:EnableMotion(true) end
    crate:SetPos(Vector(700, -200, -123.6))
    RunConsoleCommand("bot")
  end
  if t == 70 then
    for _, b in ipairs(player.GetBots()) do if b ~= bot then other = b end end
    if IsValid(other) then other:SetPos(Vector(700, -540, -143.6)) other:SetEyeAngles(Angle(0, -90, 0)) end
  end
  if t == 150 then
    if IsValid(other) then other:SetPos(Vector(400, -200, -143.6)) end
    crate:SetPos(Vector(700, -550, -123.6)) crate:GetPhysicsObject():SetVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
  end
  if t >= 0 and (t % 10 == 0 or t < 6 or (t >= 100 and t < 145) or (t >= 198 and t < 230)) then
    local tr = bot:GetEyeTrace()
    samples[#samples+1] = { t = t, hit = IsValid(tr.Entity) and tr.Entity:GetClass() or "", crate = crate:GetPos(),
      other = IsValid(other) and { pos = other:GetPos(), hp = other:Health(), vel = other:GetVelocity() } or nil,
      carrying = IsValid(bot:GetActiveWeapon()) and bot:GetActiveWeapon():GetClass() or "", picked = IsValid(crate:GetParent()) or crate:IsPlayerHolding() }
  end
  if t == 250 then
    for _, h in ipairs({ "Think", "PlayerUse", "KeyPress", "StartCommand", "SetupMove" }) do hook.Remove(h, "parity_use_hold") end
    done({ uses = uses, samples = samples })
  end
end)
return "async"
